found.title: Pontkade
found.why: The Pontkade ring seen from the IJ by the NDSM ferry landing: blocks in mixed red, dark and brick facings, with the towers behind. Captioned as the Pontkade complex on the former NDSM yard, geotagged by the pier, 12 Sep 2024.

found.title: Schoonschip floating neighbourhood
found.why: The Schoonschip floating homes on the Johan van Hasseltkanaal in the foreground, apartment blocks behind; the caption names Schoonschip, geotagged at the site, 9 Oct 2025. Wide shot, not a close-up.

found.title: Smiley
found.why: Foto 7: the stepped roof terraces of the long yellow-brick block, 17 Dec 2017. Foto 5: the full length of the curving block from its tall end, 17 Dec 2017. Foto 6: the street front with shop units, 17 Dec 2017. Files have no caption or geotag, only Category:Kees Broekmanstraat; I identified Smiley from the stepped terraces and long curve. Not foto 1-4, which show a different block with balconies.

found.title: Steven Holl's copper pavilion on the Singelgracht (Sarphatistraat 410)
found.why: 2872364545: the green copper pavilion from across the Singelgracht, 19 Sep 2008. 52902205309: the pavilion from the courtyard beside the old warehouse, 16 May 2023. Both in Category:Kantoorgebouw Het Oosten. Not the 2011 'Amsterdam - Sarphatistraat 410' files, which show only the 19th-century street front.

found.title: Ruby Emma Hotel (ex QO)
found.why: (1): the glass tower seen down the Amstelvlietstraat, 7 Apr 2019. (2): the tower from the south-east, 7 Apr 2019. Both captioned 'QO-hotel aan de Amstelvlietstraat'. Taken under the QO name, before the Ruby rebrand; the exterior is unchanged.
